meta.description: Registry for bounded interaction behavior between selection rules, multi-branch retention, and admissibility-sensitive pruning systems in Phase 3.

selection_retention_interaction_entries.name: Selection-Retention Interaction
selection_retention_interaction_entries.purpose: Represent bounded interaction behavior between selection rules, multi-branch retention, and admissibility-sensitive pruning systems.

selection_retention_conditions.name: multi_branch_retention_remains_defined
selection_retention_conditions.description: Formal support for maintaining multiple concurrent continuation paths through selection-pruning cycles.

selection_retention_conditions.name: selection_pruning_interaction_remains_bounded
selection_retention_conditions.description: The combined effect of selection rules and pruning thresholds must not result in unbounded complexity or total witness loss.

selection_retention_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_pruning_bias_remains_detectable
selection_retention_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to track how frame bias influences branch survival.

selection_retention_conditions.name: residue_saturation_does_not_force_unique_branch_survival
selection_retention_conditions.description: Accumulated historical constraints must not collapse the multi-valued nature of branching into a single forced path.

selection_retention_conditions.name: recursive_selection_retention_updates_remain_admissible
selection_retention_conditions.description: Each iteration of the selection-retention process must satisfy current admissibility windows.

selection_retention_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_retention_witness
selection_retention_conditions.description: Pruning rules must ensure at least one valid candidate survives where continuation is required.

selection_retention_conditions.name: window_dynamics_do_not_force_total_branch_collapse
selection_retention_conditions.description: Dynamic window shrinkage must not result in the elimination of all possible branches.

selection_retention_conditions.name: selection_retention_instability_detectable
selection_retention_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to register breakdown in retention stability or branch fragmentation.
